structured.answer: I'd open an account at פסגות and put 750 ₪ a month into the "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" fund, which the page marks "הזול". After 15 years it says about 179,889 ₪ in today's money, from 135,000 ₪ I put in, assuming 2% inflation a year and 7% return.

stuck.why: Field showed 750 but the slider said 800; I wasn't sure which one the page was using until I saw 135,000 / 180 חודשים
Didn't understand 'מהפסד' (loss?), and the big tax number scared me a bit

used: Heading 'איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד'
Inputs סכום היום / הפקדה חודשית / שנים
Result card 'הבחירה שלכם · הזול' 179,889 ₪ 'בכסף של היום'
skimmed: Cost bar chart 'כמה זה עולה לכם ב־15 שנים'
Fund fee line דמי ניהול 0% / משתנים 0% / נאמן 0.02%
skipped: Filter chips (צוברת, עסקת החלף, מנוטרלת מט״ח etc.)
Rest of page below the cards
unsure_meaning: אם הדולר לא זז מול השקל
not_found: An explanation on the main screen of what inflation rate is assumed; I had to click the button to see 2%

findings.what: Monthly deposit slider shows 800 while the field says 750, so it's confusing which value is used
The inflation rate (2%) is hidden behind a button; the main line only says 'בכסף של היום'
findings.where: Line under the sliders / אינפלציה button

findings.what: Tax is shown as a huge pink bar labelled '84% מהפסד', which reads like a loss and is scary and unclear
The recommended fund manager (ילין לפידות) isn't a name I know, which makes me hesitate
Lots of jargon chips and fee terms I don't understand
